charts.title: Portable v5 on one roof recording
charts.caption: DS26-0036 uses the original GLRT factors and causal history. The portable wrapper and stock give identical positions.

charts.title: Portable v5 at two simulated sites
charts.caption: The original causal history drives both true and omitted tile queries at each simulated site. One correct-tile query returned a fix. The other correct query and both omitted queries reached the 180-second deadline.

charts.title: Portable v5 · two simulated query retries
charts.caption: The second correct-tile query and first omitted query reuse the exact original packets. Both retries reached 195 seconds. The four original attempts have a separate chart.
